description: This file defines a Java class 'ProductList' that models a collection of products, including methods to access and modify the list of products and the total product count.

classes.name: ProductList
classes.description: A Java class representing a list of readable products with associated metadata such as product count.

methods.name: setProducts
methods.description: Sets the list of ReadableProduct objects.

methods.name: getProducts
methods.description: Returns the list of ReadableProduct objects.

methods.name: getProductCount
methods.description: Returns the total count of products.
